component.name: Cadence
component.summary: Timetable and daily planner with widgets, reminders and alarms

description.p: Cadence keeps your class timetable or daily routine one glance away. Set up your week once, then see what is on now and what comes next from the app, a desktop widget or your phone's home screen.

ul.li: Week and day views of your timetable
A desktop widget that shows what is on now and next
Daily routines for work and life, including overnight blocks such as sleep
Reminders and alarms, per class or activity
Lab groups and electives, so you only see the classes you attend
Day overrides, such as a Saturday that follows Monday's timetable
Tasks and exams alongside your classes
Start on sign-in and run from the system tray
JSON backup and restore, plus ICS export to other calendars
Fully offline: your data stays on your device and nothing is tracked
